# GLASS paired GBM COL analysis

We hypothesize that when comparing primary and recurrent GBM, COLI and III expression will be upregulated in recurrent GBM. 

## Libraries
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install("EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75")
BiocManager::install("edgeR")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
glass_dir  <- "/Data/Inputs/GLASS"
count_file <- file.path(glass_dir, "transcript_count_matrix_all_samples.tsv")

# Load entire matrix
counts_raw <- read.delim(
  count_file,
  check.names  = FALSE,
  comment.char = "",   # preserve any "#" lines
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Look at structure
head(counts_raw)
str(counts_raw[, 1:5])
```

```{r}

counts_tx <- counts_raw %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = colnames(counts_raw)[1])

```

```{r}
tx_id <- "ENST00000304636"

# Does this transcript exist in the dataset?
tx_exists <- tx_id %in% rownames(counts_tx)
tx_exists

```

```{r}
counts_tx[tx_id, 1:10]     # show first 10 samples
sum(counts_tx[tx_id, ])    # total counts across all samples
summary(as.numeric(counts_tx[tx_id, ]))   # distribution of counts

```
## DE Analysis

Building Meta data from GLSS sample IDs

```{r}

# Rebuild metadata fresh from the current count matrix
sample_ids <- colnames(counts_tx)

# Use regex to pull out site, patient, and tumor code
# Pattern: GLSS-<SITE>-<PATIENT>-(TP or R1/R2/...)- 
m <- str_match(sample_ids, "^GLSS-([A-Z0-9]{2})-([A-Z0-9]+)-(TP|R[0-9]+)-")

meta2 <- tibble(
  sample_id  = sample_ids,
  site       = m[, 2],                                   # e.g. "19", "CU", "HF"
  patient_id = m[, 3],                                   # raw patient code, can start with letter
  patient    = ifelse(is.na(m[, 2]) | is.na(m[, 3]),
                      NA_character_,
                      paste0("GLSS-", m[, 2], "-", m[, 3])),  # full patient ID
  tumor_code = m[, 4],                                   # "TP", "R1", "R2", etc.
  tumor_type = case_when(
    tumor_code == "TP"             ~ "Primary",
    str_detect(tumor_code, "^R")   ~ "Recurrent",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
)

# Look at what we got
head(meta2)
table(meta2$tumor_type, useNA = "ifany")
sum(is.na(meta2$patient))

```

```{r}
## Add sample_barcode combining patient and tumor_code

meta2 <- meta2 %>%
  mutate(
    sample_barcode = ifelse(
      is.na(patient) | is.na(tumor_code),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(patient, "-", tumor_code)
    )
  )

# Quick check
head(meta2 %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, patient, tumor_code, sample_barcode))

```
### Filter IDH-WT GBM
```{r}
## Filter meta2 to only Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype using sample_barcode

# 1) Load clinical_surgeries
clin <- read.delim(
  file.path(glass_dir, "clinical_surgeries.tsv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 2) Standardize names
names(clin) <- tolower(names(clin))

# 3) Get the list of sample_barcodes that are GBM, IDH-wildtype
gbm_barcodes <- clin %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(who_classification),
    who_classification == "Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype"
  ) %>%
  pull(sample_barcode) %>%
  unique()

length(gbm_barcodes)  # how many GBM IDH-wt samples exist?

# 4) Subset meta2 to ONLY those barcodes
meta2 <- meta2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_barcode %in% gbm_barcodes)

# 5) Sanity checks
nrow(meta2)
length(unique(meta2$patient))
table(meta2$tumor_type, useNA = "ifany")

```

Filtering data to only include paired samples. 
```{r}
## Filter to non-NA tumor_type and build paired GBM, IDH-wt set

# 1) Drop samples without a tumor_type
meta2_clean <- meta2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tumor_type))

table(meta2_clean$tumor_type)

# 2) Identify patients with BOTH Primary and Recurrent
paired_patients <- meta2_clean %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(n_types = n_distinct(tumor_type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_types == 2) %>%
  pull(patient)

length(paired_patients)  # number of truly paired GBM IDH-wt patients

# 3) Keep only samples from those paired patients
meta_paired2 <- meta2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(patient %in% paired_patients)

# 4) Subset counts to those samples
counts_tx2 <- counts_tx[, meta_paired2$sample_id]

# 5) Align metadata order to count matrix columns
meta_paired2 <- meta_paired2[match(colnames(counts_tx2), meta_paired2$sample_id), ]

# 6) Sanity checks
table(meta_paired2$tumor_type)
length(unique(meta_paired2$patient))
all(colnames(counts_tx2) == meta_paired2$sample_id)

```

Build transcript for gene mapping and clean ENST ID
```{r}

## Transcript → gene mapping and aggregation to gene level

edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75

# 1) Transcript → gene mapping from EnsDb
tx_annot <- transcripts(
  edb,
  columns = c("tx_id", "gene_name"),
  return.type = "DataFrame"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", tx_id)   # drop version suffix
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(tx_id_clean, gene_name) %>%
  distinct()

# 2) Clean GLASS transcript IDs in the paired count matrix
counts_tbl <- counts_tx2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("raw_tx") %>%
  mutate(
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\|.*$", "", raw_tx),       # drop anything after '|'
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", tx_id_clean)   # drop version suffix
  )

# 3) Join counts with annotation
merged <- inner_join(counts_tbl, tx_annot, by = "tx_id_clean")

nrow(merged)
length(unique(merged$gene_name))

# 4) Aggregate transcript counts → gene-level counts for paired samples
sample_cols <- colnames(counts_tx2)

counts_gene_paired2 <- merged %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ sum(as.numeric(.))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Diagnostics
dim(counts_gene_paired2)
head(counts_gene_paired2[, 1:5])
summary(as.numeric(counts_gene_paired2))

```

```{r}
## ==== Paired ΔCOL directionality (Primary → Recurrent) ====

outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS/Paired_DeltaCOL"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

# 0) Sanity: keep only Primary/Recurrent + required fields
meta_pair <- meta_paired2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type %in% c("Primary", "Recurrent")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent")),
    # parse recurrence number from tumor_code (R1, R2, ...)
    recur_num = dplyr::if_else(
      str_detect(tumor_code, "^R[0-9]+$"),
      as.integer(str_remove(tumor_code, "^R")),
      NA_integer_
    )
  )

# 1) Keep ONLY patients with both Primary and Recurrent
paired_patients <- meta_pair %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(n_types = n_distinct(tumor_type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_types == 2) %>%
  pull(patient)

meta_pair <- meta_pair %>%
  filter(patient %in% paired_patients)

cat("Paired patients (have TP + R):", n_distinct(meta_pair$patient), "\n")

# 2) Choose ONE Primary + ONE Recurrent per patient
# Rule:
#   - Primary: take first TP encountered
#   - Recurrent: take earliest recurrence number (R1 before R2), tie-break by first encountered
meta_pair_1 <- meta_pair %>%
  group_by(patient, tumor_type) %>%
  arrange(
    dplyr::if_else(is.na(recur_num), 9999L, recur_num),
    sample_id
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Chosen samples:\n")
print(table(meta_pair_1$tumor_type))

# 3) Build logCPM from gene-level paired counts (selected samples only)
counts_pair <- counts_gene_paired2[, meta_pair_1$sample_id, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_pair) == meta_pair_1$sample_id))

y <- DGEList(counts = counts_pair)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
logcpm <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

# 4) Compute Δ per collagen gene and mean ΔCOL
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")
present <- col_genes[col_genes %in% rownames(logcpm)]
cat("Collagen genes present:", paste(present, collapse = ", "), "\n")
stopifnot(length(present) >= 2)

expr_long <- logcpm[present, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "logcpm") %>%
  left_join(meta_pair_1 %>% select(sample_id, patient, tumor_type), by = "sample_id")

delta_tbl <- expr_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(patient, gene),
    names_from = tumor_type,
    values_from = logcpm
  ) %>%
  mutate(delta = Recurrent - Primary)

delta_score <- delta_tbl %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(
    delta_COL_mean = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5) Directionality summary + sign/binomial test (per gene + mean score)
dir_stats_gene <- delta_tbl %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_patients = sum(!is.na(delta)),
    pct_up     = mean(delta > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    median_delta = median(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_sign = binom.test(
      x = sum(delta > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(delta)),
      p = 0.5,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dir_stats_mean <- tibble(
  gene = "COL_mean",
  n_patients = sum(!is.na(delta_score$delta_COL_mean)),
  pct_up = mean(delta_score$delta_COL_mean > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
  median_delta = median(delta_score$delta_COL_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
  p_sign = binom.test(
    x = sum(delta_score$delta_COL_mean > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(delta_score$delta_COL_mean)),
    p = 0.5,
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )$p.value
)

dir_stats <- bind_rows(dir_stats_gene, dir_stats_mean)

cat("\nDirectionality (Δ = Recurrent − Primary):\n")
print(dir_stats)

write.csv(
  dir_stats,
  file = file.path(outdir, "Directionality_DeltaCOL_SignTests.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 6) Paired slope plots (one panel per gene)
p_slope <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = tumor_type, y = logcpm, group = patient)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
             size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Paired collagen expression: Primary → Recurrent (IDH-WT GBM)",
    subtitle = "Each line is one patient; Δ computed as Recurrent − Primary",
    x = "",
    y = "logCPM"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "PairedSlope_COL1A1_COL1A2_COL3A1.pdf"),
  plot = p_slope,
  width = 10,
  height = 4
)

print(p_slope)

# 7) Save deltas for downstream steps (Options 2 & 3)
write.csv(
  delta_tbl,
  file = file.path(outdir, "DeltaTable_PerGene_PerPatient.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  delta_score,
  file = file.path(outdir, "DeltaScore_MeanCollagen_PerPatient.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
```{r}
## ==== Option 2: Concordance across collagen deltas ====

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

outdir2 <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS/Paired_DeltaCOL/Option2_Concordance"
if (!dir.exists(outdir2)) dir.create(outdir2, recursive = TRUE)

# 0) Make sure delta_tbl exists + has what we need
stopifnot(exists("delta_tbl"))
stopifnot(all(c("patient","gene","delta") %in% colnames(delta_tbl)))

# 1) Wide Δ table: one row per patient, one column per gene
delta_wide <- delta_tbl %>%
  filter(gene %in% c("COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1")) %>%
  select(patient, gene, delta) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = delta)

cat("Patients with Δ table:", nrow(delta_wide), "\n")
print(colSums(!is.na(delta_wide[, c("COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1")])))

# 2) Helper to compute correlation stats for a pair
cor_pair <- function(df, x, y) {
  d <- df %>% select(all_of(c(x, y))) %>% na.omit()
  if (nrow(d) < 5) return(NULL)

  pear <- cor.test(d[[x]], d[[y]], method = "pearson")
  spear <- cor.test(d[[x]], d[[y]], method = "spearman")

  tibble(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    n = nrow(d),
    pearson_r = unname(pear$estimate),
    pearson_p = pear$p.value,
    spearman_rho = unname(spear$estimate),
    spearman_p = spear$p.value
  )
}

pairs <- list(
  c("COL1A1","COL3A1"),
  c("COL1A1","COL1A2"),
  c("COL1A2","COL3A1")
)

cor_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(pairs, \(p) cor_pair(delta_wide, p[1], p[2])))

cat("\nΔCOL concordance correlations:\n")
print(cor_tbl)

write.csv(
  cor_tbl,
  file = file.path(outdir2, "DeltaCOL_CorrelationTable.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 3) Plot function
plot_pair <- function(df, x, y) {
  d <- df %>% select(patient, all_of(c(x, y))) %>% na.omit()

  # annotation from Pearson
  pear <- cor.test(d[[x]], d[[y]], method = "pearson")

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]])) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Δ", y, " vs Δ", x, "  (Recurrent − Primary)"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Pearson r = ", round(unname(pear$estimate), 3),
        ", p = ", signif(pear$p.value, 3),
        ", n = ", nrow(d)
      ),
      x = paste0("Δ", x, " (logCPM)"),
      y = paste0("Δ", y, " (logCPM)")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  p
}

# 4) Make + save plots
p_13 <- plot_pair(delta_wide, "COL1A1","COL3A1")
p_12 <- plot_pair(delta_wide, "COL1A1","COL1A2")
p_23 <- plot_pair(delta_wide, "COL1A2","COL3A1")

ggsave(file.path(outdir2, "DeltaScatter_COL1A1_vs_COL3A1.pdf"), p_13, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(outdir2, "DeltaScatter_COL1A1_vs_COL1A2.pdf"), p_12, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(outdir2, "DeltaScatter_COL1A2_vs_COL3A1.pdf"), p_23, width = 6, height = 5)

print(p_13)
print(p_12)
print(p_23)

# 5) Optional: “direction concordance” (same sign) summary
dir_concord <- function(df, x, y) {
  d <- df %>% select(all_of(c(x, y))) %>% na.omit()
  same <- mean(sign(d[[x]]) == sign(d[[y]])) * 100
  tibble(x = x, y = y, n = nrow(d), pct_same_sign = same)
}

dir_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(pairs, \(p) dir_concord(delta_wide, p[1], p[2])))

cat("\nSame-sign concordance (% of patients where deltas share sign):\n")
print(dir_tbl)

write.csv(
  dir_tbl,
  file = file.path(outdir2, "DeltaCOL_SameSignConcordance.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
## ==== Option 3 (Chunk 3A): Recurrent-only DE by ΔCOL induction status ====

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)

outdir3 <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS/Option3_DeltaCOL_Subset/RecurrentOnly_DE"
if (!dir.exists(outdir3)) dir.create(outdir3, recursive = TRUE)

# 0) Require objects from Option A1/Option 2 pipeline
stopifnot(exists("delta_score"))     # patient-level deltas (has delta_COL_mean)
stopifnot(exists("meta_paired2"))    # sample-level paired metadata
stopifnot(exists("counts_gene_paired2"))  # gene x sample matrix for paired cohort

# 1) Define ΔCOL group at patient level
delta_groups <- delta_score %>%
  mutate(
    delta_group = ifelse(delta_COL_mean > 0, "Induced", "NotInduced"),
    delta_group = factor(delta_group, levels = c("NotInduced", "Induced"))
  ) %>%
  select(patient, delta_COL_mean, delta_group)

cat("Patients by ΔCOL group:\n")
print(table(delta_groups$delta_group))

# 2) Build a clean paired metadata set (1 Primary + 1 Recurrent per patient)
meta_pair3 <- meta_paired2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(tumor_type)) %>%
  mutate(
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient, tumor_type) %>%
  slice(1) %>%          # <-- consistent rule
  ungroup()

# Keep only patients that have BOTH timepoints
paired_patients3 <- meta_pair3 %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(n_types = n_distinct(tumor_type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_types == 2) %>%
  pull(patient)

meta_pair3 <- meta_pair3 %>% filter(patient %in% paired_patients3)

# 3) Recurrent-only samples and attach ΔCOL group
meta_rec3 <- meta_pair3 %>%
  filter(tumor_type == "Recurrent") %>%
  inner_join(delta_groups, by = "patient")

cat("\nRecurrent samples in DE:", nrow(meta_rec3), "\n")
print(table(meta_rec3$delta_group))

# 4) Subset gene-level counts to recurrent-only samples
counts_rec3 <- counts_gene_paired2[, meta_rec3$sample_id, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_rec3) == meta_rec3$sample_id))

# 5) limma-voom DE: Induced vs NotInduced (Recurrent only)
y3 <- DGEList(counts = counts_rec3)

keep3 <- rowSums(y3$counts) >= 10
y3 <- y3[keep3, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

y3 <- calcNormFactors(y3)

design3 <- model.matrix(~ delta_group, data = meta_rec3)
v3 <- voom(y3, design3, plot = FALSE)
fit3 <- lmFit(v3, design3)
fit3 <- eBayes(fit3)

res_rec_delta <- topTable(
  fit3,
  coef = "delta_groupInduced",
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
)

cat("\nTop genes up in ΔCOL-Induced recurrent tumors:\n")
print(head(res_rec_delta, 10))

# 6) Quick sanity: COL genes should be higher in Induced recurrences (but not guaranteed)
col_check <- c("COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1")
col_check <- col_check[col_check %in% rownames(res_rec_delta)]
cat("\nCollagen genes in recurrent-only DE (Induced vs NotInduced):\n")
print(res_rec_delta[col_check, c("logFC","P.Value","adj.P.Val"), drop = FALSE])

# 7) Save results + metadata used
write.csv(
  res_rec_delta,
  file = file.path(outdir3, "DE_RecurrentOnly_Induced_vs_NotInduced.csv"),
  row.names = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  meta_rec3,
  file = file.path(outdir3, "Meta_RecurrentOnly_With_DeltaGroup.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
## ==== Option 3B: GSEA (GO BP) for Recurrent-only DE: Induced vs NotInduced ====

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(dplyr)

stopifnot(exists("res_rec_delta"))  # from Option 3A
outdir3 <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS/Option3_DeltaCOL_Subset/RecurrentOnly_DE"
if (!dir.exists(outdir3)) dir.create(outdir3, recursive = TRUE)

# 1) Rank genes by limma t-statistic (best for GSEA)
gene_ranks <- res_rec_delta$t
names(gene_ranks) <- rownames(res_rec_delta)
gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

# 2) Map SYMBOL -> ENTREZID
map <- bitr(
  names(gene_ranks),
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
)

# 3) Build ranked list keyed by ENTREZID
gene_ranks_entrez <- gene_ranks[map$SYMBOL]
names(gene_ranks_entrez) <- map$ENTREZID

# de-duplicate Entrez IDs (keep first occurrence)
gene_ranks_entrez <- gene_ranks_entrez[!duplicated(names(gene_ranks_entrez))]
gene_ranks_entrez <- sort(gene_ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)

cat("Ranked genes after mapping:", length(gene_ranks_entrez), "\n")

# 4) Run GSEA (GO Biological Process)
gsea_go_rec <- gseGO(
  geneList     = gene_ranks_entrez,
  OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont          = "BP",
  keyType      = "ENTREZID",
  minGSSize    = 10,
  maxGSSize    = 500,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  verbose      = FALSE
)

gsea_go_rec_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_go_rec)

# 5) Print top pathways enriched in Induced (positive NES)
cat("\nTop GO BP enriched in ΔCOL-Induced recurrent tumors (positive NES):\n")
print(
  gsea_go_rec_df %>%
    filter(NES > 0) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    select(ID, Description, NES, p.adjust) %>%
    head(25)
)

# 6) Save full table + a dotplot PDF
write.csv(
  gsea_go_rec_df,
  file = file.path(outdir3, "GSEA_GO_BP_RecurrentOnly_Induced_vs_NotInduced.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

pdf(file.path(outdir3, "GSEA_GO_BP_Dotplot_RecurrentOnly_Induced_vs_NotInduced.pdf"),
    width = 11, height = 6)
print(dotplot(gsea_go_rec, showCategory = 20))
dev.off()

```

```{r}
## ==== Option 3C-1: NES summary plot (positive NES only) ====

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

stopifnot(exists("gsea_go_rec_df"))

    title = "Biological programs enriched in collagen-induced recurrent GBM",
    subtitle = "Recurrent-only GSEA: ΔCOL-Induced vs NotInduced",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir3, "GSEA_NES_Top15_Positive_RecurrentOnly.pdf"),
  p_nes,
  width = 10,

)

print(p_nes)
```
